instruction: The function addPercentages in calc.js is supposed to sum a list of percentage numbers and return the total. It currently has an off-by-one bug: it skips the last element of the list. Fix calc.js so that all cases pass. Do not modify calc.test.js or _verify.js.

Create a new file stats.js in the workspace root that exports two functions via CommonJS: mean(numbers) returning the arithmetic mean (0 for an empty list), and median(numbers) returning the median (for even-length lists, the average of the two middle values; 0 for an empty list). Do not modify _verify.js.

instruction: The function getUserData is defined in user-store.js and called from profile.js and session.js. Rename it to fetchUserProfile everywhere — definition and every call site — keeping behavior identical. No file may still reference getUserData when you are done. Do not modify _verify.js.

legacy-billing.js is dead code: nothing uses its exports, and the team has decided to remove it. Delete legacy-billing.js and remove any reference to it from index.js, keeping everything else working. Do not modify _verify.js.

router.js implements a tiny route table: routes is an object mapping 'METHOD /path' to handlers, and dispatch(method, path) looks up and calls the handler. Add a route 'GET /health' handled by a function health() that returns { status: 'ok' }. Wire it so dispatch('GET', '/health') works. Do not modify _verify.js.

Implement feature: a rate limiter. Create rate-limiter.js exporting a CommonJS class RateLimiter whose constructor takes (maxEvents, windowMs) and whose method allow(key) returns true the first maxEvents times a given key is seen within windowMs milliseconds, then false until the window expires. Time must come from an injectable clock: the constructor accepts an optional third argument `now` (a function returning milliseconds) defaulting to Date.now. Do not modify rate-limiter.test.js or _verify.js. Make the provided test file pass.

instruction: config-loader.js reads config.json via a callback-style API (loadConfig(path, callback)). Refactor it to return a Promise instead: loadConfig(path) must resolve with the parsed config object and reject with the underlying error on failure. Update every caller (server.js and worker.js) to use the promise API, preserving current behavior for valid and missing files. Do not modify config.json or _verify.js.

In utils.js, the function slugify lowercases and hyphenates a title but leaks a subtle bug: consecutive whitespace collapses are missing, so 'a  b' becomes 'a--b' when it should become 'a-b'. Fix ONLY that behavior: single spaces, leading/trailing whitespace, tabs, and existing output for simple words must keep working exactly as the existing tests expect. Do not rename anything, do not reformat the file, and do not modify utils.test.js or _verify.js. The diff against utils.js should touch as few lines as possible.
